notes.title: Tutorial optimisation
notes.content:
Tutorial optimisation

[b]Hopefully the last session of the initial bug fixes. [/b]
It includes fixes for fps issues in the tutorial and also reduces the hard disk space taken up by the game.
Content updates can be expected in the coming period, but for now we've reached the end of the optimization updates for a while.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
The latest update introduced a bug in the game that caused a strange save error.
We fixed it as soon as we could.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Small update:

Fixes early fps issues.

notes.title: Little update
notes.content: Only a couple of disturbing sound effects in the background sound and a couple of visual bugs have been fixed. It couldn't be a smaller update than this.
